verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Milvus can auto-generate sparse embeddings from raw text for full-text search (BM25-style) without manual embedding generation, but there is no evidence of built-in dense embedding generation via configured model providers (e.g., OpenAI, HuggingFace) at both ingest and query time, which is the core of the story. missing for 10: documentation of configurable embedding model providers/functions for dense embeddings, evidence of embedding generation at both ingest and query time beyond sparse/full-text search, independent confirmation of this workflow in practice.
